title: Timestamp u64→i64 cast silently truncates in SQLite storage
description: sqlite_storage.rs:44-49: hlc_timestamp is u64 cast to i64 for INSERT. debug_assert catches truncation in debug builds but release builds proceed silently if hlc_timestamp > i64::MAX (year ~292M CE). Timestamp ordering breaks and DAG state becomes incoherent. Fix: return Err instead of assert, or enforce the invariant at HlcClock construction time.
